step_a: Extract red four-connected objects and compute each full D4 canonical shape-key once, storing object/signature pairs.
intermediate: The executed object/signature list, including a repeated F5 key and singleton W5 key; the witness also records executed translation-only counterfactual tags.
step_b: Count stored signatures, select the first object whose stored signature has frequency one, and render its observed normalized cyan crop without recomputing the signatures.
why_b_depends_on_a: Changing only A's stored signature from full D4 to translation-only splits the reflected common pair. Byte-identical B then selects the first common object instead of the middle singleton. Reversing stages would not be a valid control because B consumes tags supplied by A.

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (shape-key cells) (format "~a" (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?)))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur (normalize-cells cells)])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define (reflect-v cells)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) norm))))
    (define (variants cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append* (map (lambda (k)
                       (let ((rot (rotate cells k)))
                         (list (normalize-cells rot) (rotate (reflect-v cells) k))))
                     (list 0 1 2 3)))))
    (define (canonical cells)
      (first (sort (variants cells) (lambda (a b) (string<? (shape-key a) (shape-key b))))))
    (define comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
    (define tagged
      (map (lambda (obj) (list obj (shape-key (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))))) comps))
    (define counts (make-hash))
    (for ([item (in-list tagged)])
      (hash-update! counts (second item) add1 0))
    (define chosen
      (first (filter (lambda (item) (= (hash-ref counts (second item)) 1)) tagged)))
    (define odd (first chosen))
    (let* ((cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells odd)))
           (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells))))
           (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second cells)))))
      (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) cells) 8 0))))))
